definitions.explanation: The process by which fertile land becomes desert, typically as a result of drought, deforestation, or inappropriate agriculture.

examples.japanese: {砂漠化|さばくか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
{砂漠化|さばくか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{植林|しょくりん}→植林：08436_shokurin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。

⟦{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{過|か}⟦{放牧|ほうぼく}→放牧：20606_houboku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{砂漠化|さばくか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Climate change and overgrazing are said to be the main causes of desertification.

notes:
{砂漠化|さばくか} refers to the process by which fertile land becomes desert, typically due to climate change, overgrazing, or deforestation. A key term in environmental discussions.

FORMS:
⟦{砂漠|さばく}→砂漠：09508_sabaku⟧ (desert) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (becoming, -ification). The ～⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ suffix indicates a process of change: ⟦{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}→温暖化：04622_ondanka⟧ (warming), ⟦{都市|とし}{化|か}→都市化：05787_toshika⟧ (urbanization).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂漠化|さばくか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: desertification advances
- {砂漠化|さばくか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent desertification
- {砂漠化|さばくか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: desertification countermeasures
- {砂漠化|さばくか}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: prevention of desertification
